items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: Mat Domber did March of Jazz. We had a number of sets. We had some wonderful sets.

ctx.x: I doubt it. I think of that kind of situation, even at the jazz parties that exist in this country, where all the musicians certainly are of high caliber, but I would prefer at times to hear some—

Organized bands. Well just this past March, Mat Domber did March of Jazz. We had a number of sets. We had some wonderful sets. We had sets with Dave McKenna and Dick Hyman, Antti Sarpila, we had wonderful people. But there’s one thing that I just — I cannot speak highly enough of Bob, but he is an organized person. He’s organized in his personal life, and he’s organized in his musical life, it’s one and the same. And before you go on stage there is never a matter of sort of what should we play next. “Undecided”…
